mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, c1.c_name as crCNameOne, c2.c_name as crCNameTwo, c3.c_name as crCNameThree, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from CalibrationReport mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join sys_company c1 on c1.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_One left join sys_company c2 on c2.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_two left join sys_company c3 on c3.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_three left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} and mn.State=7 order by mn.State_Time desc limit 1

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, c1.c_name as crCNameOne, c2.c_name as crCNameTwo, c3.c_name as crCNameThree, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from CalibrationReport mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join sys_company c1 on c1.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_One left join sys_company c2 on c2.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_two left join sys_company c3 on c3.c_id=mn.Cr_C_Id_three left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}
